title: WORKSHOP
height: walls 2.8 m, low dome rising 1.4 m, small windows
doors: TUBE HATCH W (open, corridor to the hub)
items: MACHINE BAY 1 (4 x 3): ice mine 3 x 3
MACHINE BAY 3 (4 x 3): electronics shop 2 x 2
MACHINE BAY 4 (4 x 3): propellant farm 4 x 3
ROBOT BENCH + turntable + parts tray, screens on arms
HAND-TOOL BENCH + vise, tool board over
notes: Owner, 2026-10-07: a bigger room, all four doors kept, so the player's 3 x 3 and 4 x 3 machines fit on the open floor with walkways and standing spots. 16 x 14 m is the coordinator's pick (owner may change).

A 4 m cross of aisles runs door to door; one 4 x 3 m machine bay in each quarter against the aisles, filled in build order (farm_kinds.gd: ice mine 3x3 level 1, smelter 3x3 level 2, electronics shop 2x2 level 3, propellant farm 4x3 level 4), 2 m strips along the walls for the benches.

The robot bench stays in the room's middle, where the aisles cross (bench.tscn on the workshop's middle). The equipment bench's 0.42 m platform is dropped (owner, playtest 3: too many floor levels); it stands on the floor in the south strip.
Printers stand outside, not in the workshop (bible, printers overlay).
The robot on its bench and the parts tray of robot parts are not in the concept K10; they come from the machines track as rows (captain's decision, 2026-10-12), not from this plan.
